title: Windmill
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sky glow behind windmill -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='35' r='30' fill='#1a2a4a' opacity='0.3'/>
  
  <!-- windmill tower -->
  <polygon points='38,88 62,88 58,40 42,40' fill='#e8c87a'/>
  <!-- tower shading -->
  <polygon points='50,88 62,88 58,40 50,40' fill='#d4a84a'/>
  
  <!-- door -->
  <rect x='46' y='70' width='8' height='14' rx='2' fill='#8b4513'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='77' r='1' fill='#f0d060'/>
  
  <!-- window -->
  <rect x='46' y='50' width='8' height='8' rx='1' fill='#4a90d9'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='50' x2='50' y2='58' stroke='#e8c87a' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='46' y1='54' x2='54' y2='54' stroke='#e8c87a' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  
  <!-- roof / cap -->
  <polygon points='40,40 60,40 50,26' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <polygon points='50,26 60,40 50,40' fill='#a02a1f'/>
  
  <!-- hub -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='4' fill='#f0d060'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='2' fill='#e8c87a'/>
  
  <!-- windmill blades - four arms -->
  <!-- top blade -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='8' width='3' height='28' rx='1' fill='#e8e8e8'/>
  <rect x='48.5' y='8' width='3' height='14' rx='1' fill='#f5f5f5'/>
  <!-- top sail -->
  <rect x='44' y='10' width='12' height='2' rx='1' fill='#d0d0d0'/>
  
  <!-- right blade -->
  <rect x='62' y='36.5' width='28' height='3' rx='1' fill='#e8e8e8'/>
  <rect x='76' y='36.5' width='14' height='3' rx='1' fill='#f5f5f5'/>
  <!-- right sail -->
  <rect x='80' y='32' width='2' height='12' rx='1' fill='#d0d0d0'/>
  
  <!-- bottom blade -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='40' width='3' height='28' rx='1' fill='#e8e8e8'/>
  <rect x='48.5' y='54' width='3' height='14' rx='1' fill='#f5f5f5'/>
  <!-- bottom sail -->
  <rect x='44' y='64' width='12' height='2' rx='1' fill='#d0d0d0'/>
  
  <!-- left blade -->
  <rect x='10' y='36.5' width='28' height='3' rx='1' fill='#e8e8e8'/>
  <rect x='10' y='36.5' width='14' height='3' rx='1' fill='#f5f5f5'/>
  <!-- left sail -->
  <rect x='18' y='32' width='2' height='12' rx='1' fill='#d0d0d0'/>
  
  <!-- ground / hill -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='35' ry='8' fill='#4a8c3f'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='25' ry='5' fill='#5ea84f'/>
  
  <!-- little flowers on ground -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='89' r='1.5' fill='#ff6b9d'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='90' r='1.5' fill='#ff6b9d'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='92' r='1.2' fill='#f0d060'/>
  
  <!-- grass tufts -->
  <path d='M20,90 Q22,86 24,90' fill='none' stroke='#3a7a2f' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <path d='M68,91 Q70,87 72,91' fill='none' stroke='#3a7a2f' stroke-width='1.2'/>
</svg>
